articles.summary: Industry Innovator Delivers Powerful Solutions for Customers Over Four Decades NETSCOUT ® (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of observability, AIOps, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection solutions, today celebrates the issuance of its 750 th patent.
